newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares ease, block trading heavy.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares ease, block trading heavy.

text.p: *The index of the official trading list down 3.09 points to 919.41.
*The Group A index dropped 35.54 points to 2,117.07.
*The Litin G index down 4.34 points to 1,915.92.
*Trading volume rose to one million litas from 630,000 on the central market
*Block trades steady at about 2.4 million litas.
*Lithuanian Gas at 0.97 litas in block trades worth 540,000 litas.
*Snaige fridge producer active in block trades, turning over about 280,000 litas.
Lithuanian shares were down on Tuesday amid active block trading that brokers attributed to recent changes in the rules.
"It's now possible to do block trades at any price the seller and buyer agree to...we're happy that the stock exchange changed the regulations," one broker said.

Previously shares in A list or official list companies could not be swapped in block trades at a price ten percent above or below its price on the central market. The fluctuation limit for most other shares was 20 percent.
Lithuanian Gas led block trades in company shares, turning over 540,000 litas at 0.97 litas a share. Its central market price fell to 1.80 litas from 1.95 in turnover of 5,189.40 litas.

Snaige, which was active in block trades last week amid rumours that Estonia's Hansa Bank had bought five percent of its shares, turned over 280,000 litas in block trades and its price ranged from 11.98 to 12.00 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese turned over 230,000 litas worth of block trades at 20.00 litas a share.
"For the buyer, it's a very good deal to get Rokishkis at 20.00 litas," a broker said. "Maybe the seller needed money."
Rokishkis moved up to 44.00 litas from 43.50 on the central market.
Hermis Bank led block trades in banking shares at 680,000 litas.
In central market activity, Alytaus Textile stayed steady at 0.20 litas but turned over 460,000 litas in trading.
Birzai Dairy, which entered the official trading list on Monday, stayed steady at 10.25 litas in 120,000 litas turnover.
"I'm absolutely sure there is somebody that wants to support that price above 10.00 litas," said another broker.
-- Burton Frierson, Vilnius newsroom +370 2 22 35 18
